Maxes out Sword's Guard Resistance, Efficiency, and Endurance.
Perfectly timed blocks heal for 80(?) HP.

Blocking Specifics:
Swords grant 90% Damage Resistance.
Sword Energy does not decay from blocking damage or holding guard.

Grants 100 Guard Resistance, Guard Efficiency, and Guard Endurance to Swords. Sword Energy does not decay from guarding or blocking damage.

Blocking a hit within 0.5 seconds of starting to guard restores 80(?) HP.

Guarding grants 80% Damage Resistance. This in increased to 90% with Aggressive Frame Swords.

Maxes out the Guard Resistance, Guard Efficiency, and Guard Endurance of Swords.

Grants <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resistance while Blocking.

Blocking with Aggressive Frame Swords grants a total of <pve 95% /> <pvp [91%] /> Damage Resistance. Blocking with other Sword Frames grants <pve 90% /> <pvp [82%] /> Damage Resistance.

Sword Energy does not decay from blocking damage or holding guard.

//Grants Restoration x2 after you stop Blocking for ? to ? seconds depending on the number of Shots Blocked.
Grants Restoration x2 for 3 seconds on any Sword Hits (including unpowered). Duration cannot be refreshed.

(Bugged? Should be granting Restoration after you stop Blocking with the duration depending on the number of Hits blocked - which is indicated by the Perfect Guard Stacks)

Maxes out the Guard Resistance, Guard Efficiency, and Guard Endurance of Swords.

Grants <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resistance while Blocking.

Blocking with Aggressive Frame Swords grants a total of <pve 95% /> <pvp [91%] /> Damage Resistance against blocked attacks. These numbers drop to <pve 90% /> <pvp [82%] /> on other Sword Frames.

Sword Energy does not decay from blocking damage or holding guard.

//Grants Restoration x2 after you stop Blocking for ? to ? seconds depending on the number of Shots Blocked.
Grants <solar/>Restoration x2 for 3 seconds on any Sword Hits including unpowered. Duration cannot be refreshed. (Assumed to be bugged)

Maxes out the Guard Resistance, Guard Efficiency, and Guard Endurance of Swords.

While Guarding:
• Grants <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resistance.
• Blocking a hit grants 2 Stacks of Perfect Guard. Maximum of 100 Stacks. (Cannot gain stacks while a <solar/>Restoration effect is active)
• Sword Energy does not decay from blocking damage or holding guard.

All Stacks are removed if no hits have been blocked in the last 10 seconds.

Dealing Sword Damage with active Perfect Guard Stacks grants <solar/>Restoration x2:
<pve 4 /> <pvp [3] /> second duration at 1 Stack, scaling up to <pve 16 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds at 100 Stacks.

Guarding with Aggressive Frame Swords grants a total of <pve 95% /> <pvp [91%] /> Damage Resistance against blocked hits. These numbers drop to <pve 90% /> <pvp [82%] /> on other Sword Frames.
